text: When a neighbour is new, offering a specific welcome—such as pointing out the nearest bus stop—makes it easier to accept help than a vague “let me know”.
Bumblebees can learn to pull a string to reach a food reward, and can learn the task by watching another bee—a striking example of social learning in insects.
